metadata.name: ISO 45001:2018 Occupational Health and Safety Management System
metadata.description: ISO 45001:2018 specifies requirements for an occupational health and safety (OH&S) management system, with guidance for its use, to enable organizations to provide safe and healthy workplaces by preventing work-related injury and ill health and proactively improving OH&S performance.
metadata.classification_reasoning: ISO 45001 is a certifiable international management-system standard for occupational health and safety.
metadata.framework_purpose: To provide a framework to manage OH&S risks and opportunities, prevent work-related injury and ill health, and provide safe and healthy workplaces.
metadata.framework_scope: Applicable to any organization, regardless of size, type or nature, that wishes to establish, implement and maintain an OH&S management system.
metadata.target_audience: OH&S / EHS Managers, Safety Officers, HR, Operations Managers, Top Management
metadata.certification_body: Accredited Certification Bodies (e.g., BSI, DNV, Bureau Veritas, SGS, Lloyd's Register)
metadata.regulatory_authority: None (voluntary certification; underlying OH&S laws are jurisdiction-specific)
adoption_approach: Secure leadership commitment and define scope
Identify hazards and assess OH&S risks
Implement operational controls and emergency response
